name: Cryptography and Cryptanalysis
description: Classical ciphers and their cryptanalysis; basic number theory; public key cryptography, prime number generation, factoring of large composite numbers; discrete logarithm and Diffie–Hellman key exchange, algorithms for computing discrete logarithms; hashing, digital signature schemes, SHA; finite fields, polynomials over finite fields, irreducible polynomials, primitive polynomials, pseudo-randomness, pseudorandom generators, linear and nonlinear shift register sequences; symmetric key cryptosystems and their cryptanalysis; block ciphers; elliptic curve cryptography; elliptic curve factoring algorithm; zero-knowledge protocols; secret sharing; side-channel attacks; lattice-based cryptography.
